title: Adjectives ending -ed and -ing
en:
-ed adjectives describe how a person feels: I'm bored. She was surprised. We were tired.

-ing adjectives describe the thing or person that causes the feeling: The meeting was boring. The results were surprising. It was a tiring day.

Common pairs: interested / interesting, excited / exciting, worried / worrying, confused / confusing, disappointed / disappointing, embarrassed / embarrassing, relaxed / relaxing, amazed / amazing.
ru: -ed — что чувствует человек (I'm bored — мне скучно). -ing — что вызывает чувство (The meeting is boring — совещание скучное). Пары: interested/interesting, worried/worrying, confused/confusing, disappointed/disappointing.

boss.situation: Describe your last week at work: 3 sentences about how you felt (-ed) and 3 about things or events (-ing).
samples: On Monday I was very tired after the trip.
The training on Tuesday was really interesting.
I was surprised by the audit results.
The new procedure is a bit confusing.
I'm excited about the new project.
It was a tiring but satisfying week.

qs.q: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
qs.exp: The film causes the feeling → boring.

qs.q: The instructions are very ___. Nobody understands them.
She was ___ when she got the job offer.
“I am boring” means the same as “I am bored”.
qs.exp: I am boring = other people find me boring!

qs.q: “The results were disappointing” describes the results.
We were very ___ (worry) about the deadline.

qs.exp: The presentation causes the feeling → amazing.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the new system is very confusing

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i was surprised by the results

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: it was a really tiring day

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I'm very interesting in finance.”
a: I am very interested in finance.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The meeting was very bored.”
Correct the mistake: “We were disappointing with the results.”
a: We were disappointed with the results.
We were disappointed by the results.
I was bored at the meeting.
I was bored in the meeting.
I was bored during the meeting.
This is a very interesting project.
It is a very interesting project.
I'm tired after a long day.
I am tired after a long day.
I was tired after a long day.
I'm tired after the long day.
